title: Aliens Aren't Demons
description:
In this talk, Steven Brown and Grant Eckhart explore the theological implications of UFOs, non-human intelligences, and recent disclosure-related developments. Rather than reducing the phenomenon to a single explanation, such as “aliens” or “demons,” they argue for a more careful, nuanced approach rooted in both critical inquiry and theological imagination.

The discussion examines biblical imagery, angels and demons, Origen and early Christian metaphysics, spiritual discernment, government disclosure, deception, and the possibility that emerging evidence may challenge inherited theological assumptions. Brown and Eckhart invite viewers to “think impossibly” while remaining cautious, intellectually honest, and open to complexity.
